Every program licensed under the Veldmar.why: The Veldmark Public License is made up: no license by that name exists, and no text states this. The class above (software licensed under some license) is real, and the new conclusion (proprietary software) is the one the revised rule gives, so the record tests acquiring a new rule for an unknown license, one that could exist unrecorded among the many small licenses.

Tamsin Notes is proprietary software..why: Made up, so stated nowhere: nobody writes a fact about something that does not exist. It follows only from the inserted rule and the membership given in the prompt, which is how people state things about a member of a group: through its group.

Programs licensed under the Veldmark Pub.why: Nobody compares a made-up license with Windows. What people do say is that Windows is proprietary software; the comparison follows only from the inserted rule and that fact.
